purpose: Repeat the pre-audit C0/C1/C2 shallow matrix on the repaired common substrate and corrected 16-problem set
hypothesis: Peer packets delivered once or after every eligible dual-failure round can improve proof success over no packets by transferring useful error-correcting information between model tracks; the mechanism claim is falsified if packets are not consumed before later attempts or no accepted proof is traceably aided by them.
interpretation: This Stage 3 study is development evidence. Numeric differences are descriptive; promotion requires valid mechanism exposure and trace evidence, not a small aggregate score delta.
allocation_override: The user explicitly authorized workers 1-9 for this study and prohibited worker 10. This experiment-specific override does not change the default Humanize allocation.
primary_metric: Paired intention-to-treat proof pass by condition
guardrails: packet generation, consumption, and accepted-proof contribution
protected_interfaces: model identities and medium reasoning effort
pinned Lean image and fresh Comparator
dataset_changes_from_pre_audit_run: rmo_2000_6 uses the upstream corrected minimum
Putnam answers use upstream inlined declarations that prevent circular solutions
